sections.content: Use pero, *sin* *embargo*, en *cambio*, por un *lado*... por *otro* lado and *aunque* to compare advantages and disadvantages. These connectors help you present both sides before evaluating the options.

items.spanish: Por un lado, esta opción es barata; por otro lado, es menos práctica.
items.english: On the one hand, this option is cheap; on the other hand, it is less practical.

items.spanish: La primera es más rápida; en cambio, la segunda es más segura.
items.english: The first is faster; by contrast, the second is safer.

items.spanish: Aunque tiene algunas desventajas, sigue siendo una opción interesante.
items.english: Although it has some disadvantages, it is still an interesting option.

items.spanish: La opción parece atractiva; sin embargo, tiene un riesgo importante.
items.english: The option seems attractive; however, it has an important risk.

sections.content: Contrast does not require you to reject an option. It lets you weigh competing factors.
